items.title: THE BEST HOMEMADE SANDWICH BREAD | HONEY WHEAT BREAD RECIPE
items.why: a full step-by-step honey wheat bread recipe with exact measurements and technique tips throughout, not padded filler.

items.title: Sourdough vs. “Normal” Bread. What’s the Difference?
items.why: a substantive explainer on what actually makes sourdough different from yeasted bread, including how to spot fake supermarket sourdough.
items.best_label: how to spot fake sourdough at stores

items.title: This Is What Makes Sourdough Bread Healthier for You Than Every Other Bread
items.why: generic AI-narrated health-benefits listicle padded with filler intros; the glycemic index and gut sections have real content worth jumping to.

items.title: Should You Still Learn to Code?
items.why: mostly motivational framing and a stretched farmer/reaper analogy, but the Jensen Huang quote context is a genuinely useful correction.
items.best_label: Jensen Huang quote explained in context

items.title: Learn to code at 30: It's not too late... here's why
items.why: vague inspirational rambling about app store stats and a debt-to-success anecdote with no concrete coding guidance.

items.title: coding with 0 experience made me $243 in 2025 - USE this app (not chat gpt)
items.why: rambling, unedited screen-share of someone using Cursor with no coherent explanation, structure, or takeaway.

items.title: How The Internet Works | Simple Explanation
items.why: a tight, well-structured explanation of IP addresses, packets, and routers using clear analogies, no filler.

items.title: 5 Rules for Learning to Code in 2025 (That Actually Help)
items.why: a long generic 'how to learn to code' listicle from a 20-year engineer; the AI-as-sidekick and minimal-progress sections have concrete advice worth skimming to.
items.best_label: rule: use AI without skipping the work

summary_line: Two solid bread videos and one internet explainer are worth full watches; the 'should I learn to code in the AI era' cluster is mostly recycled motivational filler with a few quotable moments.
